name: Selects Clips
summary: Make a template from a channel's best shorts, then turn any long video into editable shorts that follow it.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel SDK runScript/runShell/askAI with pictures, Draft setFrameSize, setClipTransform and addMotionGraphic, project transcription, and the panel runtime FileSystem service. No Python or separate setup.

en.name: Selects Clips
en.summary: Make a template from a channel's best shorts, then turn any long video into editable shorts that follow it.

de.name: Selects Clips
de.summary: Erstellen Sie aus den erfolgreichsten Shorts eines Kanals eine Vorlage und machen Sie aus jedem langen Video bearbeitbare Shorts in diesem Stil.

es.name: Selects Clips
es.summary: Crea una plantilla a partir de los mejores clips cortos de un canal y convierte cualquier vídeo largo en clips cortos editables que la siguen.
